additional_info.subject: Status update
additional_info.body:
Discussed the topic today with Markus. The test session reported was performed by Markus, and from logs it is clear a severe unusual toggling of CP state. Charging session could not start, and from HMI all 4 status messages were loading.
After plug out and plug in, session started.
Markus states that this behavior happens quite often, and is asking if it could be related to EcoG.
Issue reported was on v7.0.5 + ecog 1.4.11.
Charger is now on v8.0.5: Deeper analysis to be done in the next weeks.

Charger MP / P9 170001028
https://configuration.sicharge.technology/chargers/ZligFW/detail
Is still having major issues causing frustration for customer.
They called and said that chargign cars there is no issues, but with eActros 300 and eActros 600 seems like there is two issues.
Starting the charging session is often difficult, they have to sometimes try 10 times before it starts.
2. When the charging start the charging stops suddenly after some times. Depedent on charging power and weather outside.
Cars can charge forever - Charging power less than 100 kW
eActros 300 which chargers 160 kW can charge around 30 minutes.
eActros 600 which takes chargers full 200 kW can only charge 10 minutes then it fails and need to be replugged.
If they put the truck in eco charging mode which limits the charging power to 100 kW they can charge the whole night.
Customer stated that if weather is very hot it will fail faster.
They had lot of trouble satrting the truck this morning

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0443612-DC/Si-D/FI-[MP / P9 170001028]- Multiple attempts are needed to start a charging session on DC2 CRM:02684000481
additional_info.body:
Hello colleagues,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0443612
. The ticket was opened for issues to attempt to start a charging session on charger
MP / P9 170001028
, requiring several attempts to establish a connection with the EV and start the charging session.
Last week Sakari provided me with further feedback, stating that:
"
Cars can charge forever - Charging power less than 100 kW
eActros 300 which chargers 160 kW can charge around 30 minutes.
eActros 600 which takes chargers full 200 kW can only charge 10 minutes then it fails and need to be replugged."
Also, weather conditions and heat was brought into the discussion as a possible root cause for limited power/derating.
In order for me to perform a deeper analysis, I would need some further information:
Could you please provide me with timestamps for each type of event the customer is facing?
Could you please underline which type of EVMAC is referred to eActross 600 and which to eActross 300?
It is important for us to distinguish which failing pattern or issues are related to which type of vehicle. From CS side, we are already in contact with Daimler for charging interruptions and issues to initiate the session with eActross 600, and several conversations and tests are already ongoing between Siemens and Daimler in different sites of Europe. Therefore, it is important for me to understand, based on timestamps, which pattern are we facing and if it is happening also at your site.
We do not have knowledge of any open issue with eActross 300. Please provide me timestamps so I can check the logs.
Many thanks in advance for your feedback!
Looking forward to hearing form you soon!
With kind regards,
